questions.subject: physics
questions.content: A real gas behaves like an ideal gas if its

options.content: pressure and temperature are both high
pressure and temperature are both low
pressure is high and temperature is low
pressure is low and temperature is high

questions.explanation:
In an ideal gas, the average force of attraction between the molecules and volume of the molecules (in
comparison to volume of the gas) are negligibly small.
These conditions are satisfied for a real gas when pressure is low and temperature is high.
